references_used.how_used: Sole source of structure and section order. Read locally — nothing was scraped for layout. Section order inherited unchanged: hero (full-bleed media + floating quote card) → promise bar → services grid → testimonials → promise band → signature system → 4-step process strip on a dark band → about with checklist → long-form SEO body → FAQ → recent articles → closing CTA.
Fonts, colours and logo ONLY, via Firecrawl's branding extractor. No layout, no component styling, no CSS beyond font-family and colour values. See the anti-pattern lock in intake-from-web.

palette.rationale: #3fa8f3 is the client's own detected brand blue and is kept exactly as the button fill. The dark band colour #0b1a2b is a deep night navy rather than the template's default olive — the product this company sells is what a property looks like after dark, so the dark sections should read as night. The surface is a very faint blue-grey pulled from the same hue family so section fills relate to the accent instead of sitting beside it.

contrast_audit.method: The contrast script in astro-templates/owl/README.md (WCAG 2.1 relative luminance, 4.5:1 threshold).
contrast_audit.note: The brand blue #3fa8f3 measures 2.59:1 against white, so it can never be body text — hence accent_ink at #1268a8. On the navy band the brand blue itself would pass at 6.77:1, but the eyebrows and step labels there run 0.75-0.95rem, so accent_on_dark is lifted to #6cbef7 for headroom.

typography.rationale: Poppins is the client's detected brand font and carries their existing identity; it is a geometric sans that reads clean and modern at display sizes. Poppins is poor at long-form body sizes, so Inter carries body text — the same split the template already assumes. Source Sans Pro appeared in the Duda fallback stack and was ignored as platform boilerplate, not brand.

motion: Template default. No parallax, no scroll-jacking, no entrance animations added.
imagery_direction: Use the client's own night photography throughout — it is the strongest asset they have and the whole product is a night-time effect. Hero and dark bands should be night shots; the about and SEO-body figures can be the landscape-lighting and café frames for tonal variety. No stock photography of any kind.
anti_patterns: purple / indigo / violet accents (unless explicitly requested)
generic construction stock photo (handshake, diverse team in hardhats, generic hard-hat closeup)
Lucide icon rows (max 1 outline icon per section, semantic only)
"Trusted by 10,000+ customers" without a real number from GBP
randomized section order — always use the fixed order from the template
a star rating or review-count badge — Bridges Lighting Pros has no verified reviews, and the 4.8/118 belongs to Bridges Elite Landscapes
branded programme names lifted from another company — the signature-system block must be named by this client
any published per-foot or per-job price the client has not agreed to
